_comment: Copy to appsettings.Local.json (git-ignored) when running without Aspire. Aspire injects all of this by itself.

Database.AppRolePassword: <any strong password; the initializer sets it on the application login role>

SigningKeys.Secret: <at least 32 random characters; signs the access tokens>

anthropic.ApiKey: <ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; sin clave los tiers de anthropic no se pueden llamar>
